one_line: says what will happen, by when
falsifier: the date arrives with the observable in another state
predict_frame: Observe the entity and state what you EXPECT to see by the resolution date. Every claim needs an observable a stranger could check and a date. A claim with no date is not a forecast.
assess_frame: The date has arrived. Did the stated observable reach the stated state? Grade hit / partial / miss / unresolvable, and say which.
